notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l002: битте: castrate, checked in Yudakhin; violent livestock comparison retained. https://el-sozduk.kg/битте/
notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l003: айдар: retained forelock marker; the verse does not identify a modern hairstyle or nationality beyond its own narrative labels.
notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l004: Lexical correction: таш сайынган means a Chinese/Kalmyk official wearing a distinguishing ball/button on the cap, Yudakhin таш I.5 https://el-sozduk.kg/таш/. In this formula таза means finest, not bald/shaven: Yudakhin таза3 https://el-sozduk.kg/ТАЗ/. Raw source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l010: Жоон is treated as the named giant Joon, with жору куйрук rendered vulture-tailed.
notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l023: Каканчылуу is provisionally interpreted as possessing a Kakan/ruler; not normalized to a modern imperial title.
notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l028: соргон: draining/sucking image retained; compare the explicit horse-and-rider swallowing image p240:l037.
notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l038: мент кылган: destructive idiom, not the modern Russian slang homograph. https://el-sozduk.kg/ment--2/
notes.manas-2010:p0228:b001:l048: Бурут is the narrative exonym for the Kyrgyz, retained in hostile speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0229:b001:l008: Joloy speaks as if life has departed, although he continues speaking and escapes; hyperbole not repaired into a literal death.
notes.manas-2010:p0229:b001:l014: Seven batmans retained as a historical weight measure without imposing a fixed modern conversion; eight follows at l018.
notes.manas-2010:p0229:b001:l016: Seven thousand giants is the printed number and not harmonized with other battle totals.
notes.manas-2010:p0229:b001:l021: жин жыттанган literally smelling of jinn/demons; may figuratively convey ferocious rage. Literal image provisional, not a claim of possession.
notes.manas-2010:p0229:b001:l025: Bucket of blood retains the hyperbolic head image rather than estimating blood loss.
notes.manas-2010:p0229:b001:l040: Чынмачынды Каканчын is syntactically compressed. Chynmachyn and Kakanchyn retained; their relation and whether a people, region or ruler is intended remain uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0229:b001:l045: менде interpreted as mortal/person, as elsewhere in the epic, not locative in me.
notes.manas-2010:p0230:b001:l001: Чоң Жинди means Great Madman, the concealing nickname; transliterated Chong Jindi rather than silently replaced by Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0230:b001:l004: сынчы: expert judge/diviner, provisionally seer here; not a modern literary critic.
notes.manas-2010:p0230:b001:l019: Twelve bodily parts is a traditional whole-body formula, not a modern anatomical enumeration.
notes.manas-2010:p0230:b001:l021: була: possessions/valuables, checked in Yudakhin. https://el-sozduk.kg/була/
notes.manas-2010:p0230:b001:l025: бейпай: torment/ruin; phrase checked against dictionary senses. https://el-sozduk.kg/бейпай/
notes.manas-2010:p0230:b001:l042: Fly-like soul/life is an epic fragility image, retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0230:b001:l045: The broken-spine assertion remains Joloy’s hyperbolic lament; no anatomical reconciliation with his continued riding.
notes.manas-2010:p0231:b001:l018: Pronoun is implicit in акылы айран бөлүндү; their minds provisionally links it to the defeated champions. Joloy’s own bewilderment is also possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0231:b001:l021: жалаңкыч: devouring monster image; no specific folklore creature substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0231:b001:l031: жолум үй: small temporary/travel dwelling, not a full fixed-size yurt measurement.
notes.manas-2010:p0231:b001:l035: ок can refer to a projectile generally; bullet retained with preceding impenetrable coat, without dating the narrated weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p0231:b001:l040: Oiled-wheat face image retained; suggests complexion/gleam rather than a literal coating.
notes.manas-2010:p0231:b001:l043: кылым here interpreted as peoples/world, not a hundred-year interval.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l001: шай колдогон: protected/favored idiom; sacred protection is deliberately broad, with possible Shaymerden association left unasserted. https://el-sozduk.kg/шай/
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l006: Narrator’s truth/falsehood aside continues in metrical display rows through l015; included as verse, not excluded as prose.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l007: Conditional wording retained in the narrator’s claim about God’s knowledge; not recast as a modern historical assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l012: зайыппуруш: famous/renowned epithet, dictionary verified. https://el-sozduk.kg/зайыппуруш/
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l025: талкан grain/powder image retained across l025–026.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l028: Какайлатып: making cower/stand rigid is provisional; also resonates with Kakay battle-cry vocabulary.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l030: Forty chiltens: supernatural protecting companions, retained as a cultural term, not reduced to forty ordinary soldiers.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l031: Кырым retained as Kyrym; no unverified modern geographic equation.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l040: One man becoming a thousand is the source’s supernatural/combat image, not a troop-count addition.
notes.manas-2010:p0232:b001:l045: Same шай колдогон idiom as l001. https://el-sozduk.kg/шай/
notes.manas-2010:p0233:b001:l004: The source calls one chilten a gray tiger; transformation/manifestation not explained beyond the text.
notes.manas-2010:p0233:b001:l011: Зымырык is the fabulous bird associated with Alp Kara Kush/Simurgh in the Manas encyclopedia. https://el-sozduk.kg/зымырык/
notes.manas-2010:p0233:b001:l016: Sixty кулач retained as fathoms/armspans without metric conversion; мар is serpent vocabulary.
notes.manas-2010:p0233:b001:l025: Каптал жагым Каканчын is compressed and relation to following names is uncertain; at my flank is provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0233:b001:l026: Улуңту Дыңша, Бакбурчун retained as names; geographic or ethnic status not independently fixed.
notes.manas-2010:p0233:b001:l033: Карыкан retained as Karykan; not silently identified with a modern place.
notes.manas-2010:p0233:b001:l043: даңгыт denotes an adult male dog/wolf; dogs used in the threatened disposal context. https://el-sozduk.kg/ДАҢГЫТ/
notes.manas-2010:p0234:b001:l002: Explicit fecal epithet retained, not sanitized.
notes.manas-2010:p0234:b001:l011: Narration has shifted implicitly from fleeing Joloy to pursuing Manas: Toruchaar identifies the rider. No claim that Joloy changed horses.
notes.manas-2010:p0234:b001:l021: сопол куйрук: short/stumpy tail, corrected from long-tailed after Yudakhin check. https://el-sozduk.kg/СОПОЛ/
notes.manas-2010:p0234:b001:l034: Rumbling travel-tent comparison l034–036 lacks an explicit subject here. Literal fragment retained; not supplied with an invented bird or weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p0234:b001:l046: Muscles likened to travel tents is the printed giant-horse simile; no scale normalization.
notes.manas-2010:p0235:b001:l002: Hooves spreading like travel tents retained as epic hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p0235:b001:l009: Six circuits retained; seven circuits follows at l012 without harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0235:b001:l021: колу for the horse denotes forelegs, rendered accordingly.
notes.manas-2010:p0235:b001:l033: Plain’s throat is a topographic metaphor; re-aligned so throat remains on its own source row, not moved into l032.
notes.manas-2010:p0235:b001:l034: сары изине чөп салып is a pursuit idiom; hard upon his very tracks is contextual and provisional, not a literal act of laying grass.
notes.manas-2010:p0235:b001:l039: Дыңша retained as Dyngsha; forty-day desert description not a verified itinerary.
notes.manas-2010:p0235:b001:l046: аманат жан: life held in trust/borrowed, retained as borrowed life.
notes.manas-2010:p0236:b001:l001: жерге кирген interpreted as sunk in despair, rather than literal burial, since Joloy is fleeing.
notes.manas-2010:p0236:b001:l014: жайчы: weather conjurer using a weather stone, dictionary checked. https://el-sozduk.kg/ЖАЙЧЫ/
notes.manas-2010:p0236:b001:l019: Астындагы Жолойго has awkward spatial wording; riding ahead is contextual to the pursuit, not a raw emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0236:b001:l021: кызыталак rendered damned as an abusive formula; not presented as a literal legal divorce statement.
notes.manas-2010:p0236:b001:l026: Skirt slit a handspan is the printed bodily/clothing insult; possible sexual insinuation remains unelaborated.
notes.manas-2010:p0236:b001:l040: торгоймун interpreted as ensnare/block the path, not lark, in the verbal threat; lexical form remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0236:b001:l045: Gendered cowardice insult retained as character speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0237:b001:l005: кыйла атам: many forefathers, not multiple immediate fathers.
notes.manas-2010:p0237:b001:l008: Printed negation no livestock retained despite broader livestock abundance; no reconciliation invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0237:b001:l018: Kakanchy retained as source form; relation to Kakanchyn elsewhere not silently regularized.
notes.manas-2010:p0237:b001:l034: Беш калаа сан көчү жок is difficult; five cities’ hosts of migrants is a provisional literal rendering, and the negative is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0237:b001:l036: жети атаңдын өчү жок: no ancestral blood debt is a provisional construal of the negative claim, not an assertion that ancestors never sought revenge.
notes.manas-2010:p0237:b001:l047: союлгур is an imprecatory epithet addressed to the horse, rendered confounded.
notes.manas-2010:p0238:b001:l008: Былкылдак treated as Bylkyldak place name; its swampy/shaking sense also fits the terrain.
notes.manas-2010:p0238:b001:l016: жай таш: rain/weather stone used with water and incantation in the dictionary account; magical object, not an ordinary forecast tool. https://el-sozduk.kg/tash-8/
notes.manas-2010:p0238:b001:l026: алты сай мөндүр literally six-grooved hail; Yudakhin glosses the whole phrase as strong hail. Literal six retained without claiming a physical measurement. https://el-sozduk.kg/say-7/
notes.manas-2010:p0238:b001:l034: жыгындап: overwhelming/washing down the ditches is contextual; precise motion uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0238:b001:l036: Repeats алты сай hail formula; same lexical qualification as l026.
notes.manas-2010:p0239:b001:l005: Four fingerbreadths of facial ice retained as supernatural hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p0239:b001:l006: Кыбыла: direction of prayer/qibla, not assigned a compass bearing unsupported by location.
notes.manas-2010:p0239:b001:l021: олжоңдогон / олоктоп / олоңдогон cluster conveys swaggering, angry movement; exact expressive shades provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0239:b001:l034: The sixty horses are Kaman’s drove, as subsequent appearance and booty speech show; verse delays naming its subject.
notes.manas-2010:p0239:b001:l039: эрте сөзү кеч болуп: even an early word seeming late expresses impatience, provisionally retained as image.
notes.manas-2010:p0239:b001:l042: эки көзү төрт болуп literally two eyes becoming four: eager/anxious watching, not a physical transformation.
notes.manas-2010:p0240:b001:l004: Falcon head is an honorific self-image for the living hero.
notes.manas-2010:p0240:b001:l020: талкан сал- crushing/destructive idiom, not preparing cereal.
notes.manas-2010:p0240:b001:l027: даңгылдыгы provisionally distinction/prowess; exact nuance among spearmen needs specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p0240:b001:l037: сорчу with аты менен explicitly preserves sucking/swallowing opponents with horses; not replaced by an ordinary killing verb.
notes.manas-2010:p0240:b001:l040: Seven Beejins is the epic’s territorial formula, not seven independently located modern cities.
notes.manas-2010:p0240:b001:l043: Kyyanger and Kapsang-Too retained; historical geographic identifications unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0240:b001:l046: Жалгыз көз translated One-Eyed as the epic’s fabulous people, not an ethnographic assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p0241:b001:l004: Адам бөлгөн алыстан: isolation from other people is provisional syntax.
notes.manas-2010:p0241:b001:l009: Wolf eating an isolated Shibe is the narrator’s hostile/fabulous description, retained without modern ethnic generalization.
notes.manas-2010:p0241:b001:l017: казынaга алыптыр literally took into the treasury/state establishment; royal service is contextual, not a named office.
notes.manas-2010:p0241:b001:l018: Ninety mules is the printed feast count.
notes.manas-2010:p0241:b001:l030: All slaughtered followed by Kaman’s solitary victory retained without invented casualty exceptions.
notes.manas-2010:p0241:b001:l035: белге таңуу: a support tied at the waist, provisionally rendered as an image of Joloy’s reliance upon Kaman.
notes.manas-2010:p0241:b001:l041: бейпай сал- can mean wreak havoc/lay waste. https://el-sozduk.kg/бейпай/
notes.manas-2010:p0242:b001:l004: Dust rising from the heart is printed hyperbole; possible expressive force not replaced with a physiological account.
notes.manas-2010:p0242:b001:l006: төр rendered uplands as printed; not silently emended to төрө/lords.
notes.manas-2010:p0242:b001:l011: бичик: written document/register, rather than a specific surviving historical archive.
notes.manas-2010:p0242:b001:l015: Какайлап interpreted as shouting Kakay, the battle cry, without translating it into an invented sentence.
notes.manas-2010:p0242:b001:l019: керик: rhinoceros and an epic giant’s mount, checked in dictionary/Manas encyclopedia. https://el-sozduk.kg/кери/
notes.manas-2010:p0242:b001:l037: Whatever came within reach retains generalized wording within the duel; no additional participants invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0242:b001:l043: Spears recur after breaking at l029; the source’s formula sequence retained, no replacement weapon story supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0243:b001:l002: Forty chiltens are supernatural guardians; not asserted independent human witnesses.
notes.manas-2010:p0243:b001:l006: Corrected from Almighty: бардыгер means all that exists/is available, per Yudakhin бардигер/бардыгер, which quotes this exact strength-gathering formula. https://el-sozduk.kg/БАРД/. No source change.
notes.manas-2010:p0243:b001:l013: Twelve parts of the body is the traditional wholeness formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0243:b001:l025: Hair compared to a hand mallet retains thickness image; no unprinted braid introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p0243:b001:l029: Үзөңгүнүн боолукка interpreted as around the stirrup strap; raw grammatical irregularity left unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0243:b001:l035: The horse’s training for battle is a provisional reading of үйрөтүп in the compressed line.
notes.manas-2010:p0243:b001:l045: Greasing the hollow with fat is the grisly aftermath image, unlike the household prosperity formulas on p244.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l004: No regrets even in death is praise of Manas, not a report that he has died here.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l005: мент кылды: destroyed, checked against the older epic use. https://el-sozduk.kg/ment--2/
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l014: ичин ачырып for Toruchaar: worked hard/emptied the belly in exertion is contextual and uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l015: Slaughtered champions belong to Joloy; delayed syntax continues to l018.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l029: Idle words are useless is treated as a narratorial formula, not a claim that Kutubiy is an empty talker.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l030: Кутубий retained as Kutubiy; not conflated with another companion name.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l032: Star reckoning is the printed companion description; whether divination or navigation is intended remains open.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l038: Greased yurt coverings are a prosperity image; with plenty supplies that idiomatic sense.
notes.manas-2010:p0244:b001:l041: Greased lattice walls repeat the prosperity formula; not literal building work.
notes.manas-2010:p0245:b001:l031: Subject is provisionally Manas as protector of the forty households; could also emphasize households gaining mastery. Raw compressed syntax unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0245:b001:l033: ырыс дөө: giant blessing/fortune retained; exact dөө collocation uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0245:b001:l034: Баабедин: Baabedin/Baha al-Din devotional offering formula; no named modern practice or obligation asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0245:b001:l036: ай туяк: moon-shaped hoof epithet; sacrificial horse pledged, no astronomical measurement.
notes.manas-2010:p0245:b001:l037: Өлө турган ой кылып literally thinking of dying: remembering danger is contextual; timing remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0245:b001:l044: буурчак here tether/neck rope, not beans. Ritual humility context retained. https://el-sozduk.kg/burchak/
notes.manas-2010:p0246:b001:l001: Exposed backsides covered is an image of restored dignity/material security; explicit wording retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0246:b001:l007: Dictionary-supported literal reading: керешке is an independent noun meaning shelter/protection, not necessarily кереш + dative suffix; чер II dense woodland/thicket; булуң a recess or woodland patch. боз rendered gray as a conservative epithet; precise poetic attachment remains uncertain. Parallel Karalaev woodland-as-windbreak formulas at p163:l012 and p629:l016 support the protective metaphor. Raw unchanged. See research/PAGE246-LEXICAL-CHECK.md. https://el-sozduk.kg/керешке/ https://el-sozduk.kg/чер/ https://el-sozduk.kg/булуң/ https://el-sozduk.kg/боз/
notes.manas-2010:p0246:b001:l019: көк бөрү: mounted team game with a carcass, retained as kök börü, not an actual wolf hunt.
notes.manas-2010:p0246:b001:l021: кунан: two-year-old horse; racing not warfare here.
notes.manas-2010:p0246:b001:l030: Two reins and one lead rope conveys taking control/rule, while retaining equestrian image.
notes.manas-2010:p0246:b001:l033: олуязаада: saintly lineage/birth epithet; not independent genealogy.
notes.manas-2010:p0246:b001:l042: Буурукса provisionally when restless; restless activity versus leisure governs l042–044, exact lexical shade uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0247:b001:l003: багылан fat/fattened lamb; ширин баш tender/sweet heads, preserved within feast list.
notes.manas-2010:p0247:b001:l004: бор кайнат- boil vigorously, dictionary verified; not chalk or cannon here. https://el-sozduk.kg/bor-6/
notes.manas-2010:p0247:b001:l008: Мал күндүү: livestock-centered life/prosperity, rendered whose life was his livestock; exact epithet provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0247:b003:l003: Супа садак print corresponds to dawn formula супа садык, dictionary verified. Translation true dawn does not imply a prayer call or a bow/quiver. Raw spelling unchanged. https://el-sozduk.kg/supa/
notes.manas-2010:p0247:b003:l012: Wolf blending with the rising ground describes appearance, not a demonstrated identity; coming narrative may explain it.
notes.manas-2010:p0247:b003:l019: коржоктогон conveys looming/crouching heavy motion; exact posture provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0247:b003:l025: Бери ургандай provisionally read as peri-struck, a supernatural comparison; printed Бери retained in raw, not silently corrected. An alternative ordinary directional reading remains possible.

headings.raw: Манаска кырк чилтен, Кызырдын жолукканы Акбалтайдын кеңеши менен Манас Кошойду көздөй жөнөгөнү
headings.en: The forty chiltens and Kyzyr meet Manas; on Akbaltay’s advice, Manas sets out toward Koshoy

transcription_check.scope: All twenty pages rendered at 1600 pixels and visually inspected against source extraction. One bold two-row chapter heading separated. Body block is b001; no watermark rows occur. Raw source unchanged. Visual check confirms digital witness only, not archival transcription.

alignment_check.method: Same worker checked every Kyrgyz/English row, explicit ordered IDs and per-page counts; corrected clause placement and lexical errors. Page 246 line 7 revised from transliteration to dictionary-supported literal English; remaining epithet/syntax qualification recorded in its note.

translation_provenance: Draft translated directly from Kyrgyz extraction and page images; no acquired prior English translation used as input. Dictionary checks support selected lexemes only; no independent specialist review.
